meta.title: Clips & Highlights
meta.description: Clutches, aces, whiffs and highlights from the Gamer's Exile community. Watch, react with Respect, and post your own.
meta.newDescription: Share a highlight with the Gamer's Exile community.

header.title: Highlights From the Exile
header.lead: Clutches, aces, wild plays and glorious fails from the community. Give Respect where it's earned.

gallery.authUnavailable: Posting opens when sign-in goes live.
gallery.emptyBody: Be the first to post one. The best plays deserve an audience.
gallery.emptyFiltered: Nothing matches this filter yet. Try another game or sort.

clip.hiddenBanner: This clip is hidden from the gallery. Only you and moderators can see it.
clip.deleteConfirm: Delete this clip for good? This can't be undone.
clip.noVideo: Your browser can't play this video format.

reactions.label: Reactions
reactions.signInPrompt: Sign in to react to clips.

report.title: Report this clip
report.lead: Reports are anonymous to the uploader. Clips with several reports are hidden until a moderator reviews them.
report.done: Thanks. A moderator will take a look.

upload.title: Post a Clip
upload.lead: MP4, WebM or MOV, up to 45 MB. Keep it to the highlight; nobody needs the loading screen.
upload.signedOutBody: Clips are tied to your account so the community knows who pulled off the play.
upload.authUnavailable: Sign-in isn't available yet, so posting is switched off for now.
upload.posterFailed: No preview for this format. The clip will still post.
upload.guidelines: Only post footage you recorded or have the right to share. No NSFW, no harassment, no cheats.

errors.rate-limited: You've posted 10 clips in the last 24 hours. Try again later.

errors.size-mismatch: The upload was interrupted or corrupted. Please try again.
errors.invalid-thumb: The poster frame couldn't be saved.
errors.invalid-upload: The upload couldn't be completed. Please try again.

errors.own-clip: You can't report your own clip.
